content.text:
Per the project memory, the notifier has belonged to the Growth team since 2026-09-01, when Dana Okafor moved to Platform. Template and copy changes are signed off in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can approve. You don't need a specific named approver. I didn't check this against a CODEOWNERS file or anything else in the repo.

Two things to remember when you edit the wording:
- **Both files:** the receipt template lives in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. It has a plain-text twin, `<event>.txt`, and you should change the wording in both. Some corporate mail gateways strip HTML.
- **Variables:** keep them snake_case, and keep the same set in both files.

I can find the receipt template and draft the change if you tell me the new wording.
